Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (32 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.329), which favours a weighted combination.
